description: Tuesday 17:00: Joanne uploads a phone photo, IMG_3187.jpg, to the shared 5759 folder (a new file; its created and modified times and the folder's modified time are 17:00): the note she left on the kitchen island for the weekend. A pen sketch shows the house, Martin's boat trailer filling the driveway with an X across the driveway's mouth, and cars parked along the curb of W Sea Grape Ln under 'open house parking'; her handwriting says the trailer stays in the driveway Friday to Sunday while the family is in Orlando, open-house visitors should park on the street, and asks Brittany to put that in her post about the open house. Nothing announces it.
